title: Unilever KPI Signal Finder
why: With hundreds of brands across many countries, Unilever leadership gets a flood of KPIs from every function. This tool tests which ones actually lead changes in margin, drops the noise, and explains the latest quarter in plain words.
problem: Senior management receives hundreds of KPIs from different departments but cannot identify which indicators actually explain changes in business performance. Develop an LLM-powered decision-intelligence system that connects operational KPIs with financial outcomes and generates evidence-based executive insights.
data_note: One business group: 36 monthly KPIs from 6 functions and operating margin over 48 months (sample data).

steps.detail: 36 KPIs from 6 functions, aligned by month
Correlation with margin at lags of 0 to 3 months
Does the KPI improve a margin forecast beyond margin's own past?
Remove KPIs that move with a stronger one (|r| > 0.85)
Regression of margin on the shortlisted drivers at their lags
Contribution of each driver to the margin change
Latest month vs its own 12-month range
AI analyst answers questions in plain English

questions: Why did margin fall last quarter?
Which 5 KPIs should be on the CEO dashboard?
Which KPIs can we stop reporting?
What should supply chain focus on?
author: K Bhargav Raju
